name: delegate
description: The main loop only delegates; the mod decides each subagent's model and effort from its brief, with Apple's on-device model and, when a key is set, TypeSafe Jev (the higher class wins). When no model answers it asks you. Lookups run on haiku at low effort, implementation on sonnet, review and measurement on opus.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key (optional)
typesafe_api_key.description: With a key, Jev (TypeSafe) reads each Agent brief beside the on-device model and the higher class wins; it also answers when the on-device model cannot. Without a key Jev is skipped. The brief, which may contain code, is sent to TypeSafe when a key is set. Stored in secure storage.

main_mode.title: Main loop mode
main_mode.description: block (default): the main loop's own work tools are refused with a message that says to delegate. warn: allowed, with a toast. off: the mod only routes subagents.

main_allow.title: Extra tools the main loop may use
main_allow.description: Comma-separated tool names the main loop keeps besides the orchestration tools. A trailing * matches a prefix (mcp__my_server__*).
